findings.highlight: Behind us is Assassin, pursuing us through the trees.
findings.evidenceJa: 背後には、木々をすり抜けて追ってくるアサシンの気配。
findings.governingReading: The Japanese reports Assassin’s presence sensed behind them; the English states Assassin himself is visibly there.
findings.explanation: A perception-bound sign is promoted into direct scene fact.

findings.highlight: was thrown off-guard by a kick to the side
findings.evidenceJa: そのわき腹に蹴りを食らって弾かれた
findings.governingReading: The kick to Assassin’s flank physically knocks him away.
findings.explanation: “Thrown off-guard” describes lost readiness rather than the displayed bodily displacement.

findings.evidenceJa: 小僧の首も落とせない
findings.governingReading: Archer mocks Assassin for being unable to take the boy’s head.
findings.explanation: The English retains death but deletes the concrete beheading language from Archer’s insult.

findings.highlight: We’ll all die if that thing catches up to us.
findings.evidenceJa: アレに追いつかれたら終わりだぞ
findings.governingReading: Archer says that if it catches them, it is over.
findings.explanation: The English promotes the terminal warning into an explicit claim that every member of the group will die.

findings.evidenceJa: 地面を黒く侵食しながら
findings.governingReading: The shadow pursues them while blackly encroaching upon or corroding the ground.
findings.explanation: A destructive process is reduced to a change of surface color.

findings.highlight: As Assassin follows, he is obstructed by Archer’s efforts.
findings.evidenceJa: アサシンと、それを食い止めるアーチャーの打ち合いが続いていた
findings.governingReading: Behind Shirou, Assassin and Archer continue exchanging blows as Archer holds him back.
findings.explanation: The English removes the reciprocal continuing fight and leaves only abstract obstruction.

findings.highlight: it’s obvious that Assassin is not in control of the fight
findings.evidenceJa: アサシンはどう見ても攻めあぐねている
findings.governingReading: Assassin is plainly at a loss for how to press his attack.
findings.explanation: The English substitutes the broader judgment that he does not control the fight.

findings.evidenceJa: 逆走する形で踏み込み
findings.governingReading: Archer steps in by reversing direction against the group’s flight.
findings.explanation: The English deletes the spatial reversal that makes his counterattack legible.

findings.highlight: He cuts the white skull with one blow.
findings.governingReading: With one stroke Archer splits the white skull mask in two.
findings.explanation: The English loses the completed bisection and again names the object as a skull rather than the mask whose broken halves Assassin holds next.

findings.evidenceJa: 安心しきった顔で遠坂は言う
findings.governingReading: Rin speaks with a face wholly given over to relief.
findings.explanation: The English drops the completeness that sharpens the false-relief beat before the shadow appears.

findings.evidenceJa: もういっぱいではちきれそうな風船
findings.governingReading: The balloon is already full and on the verge of bursting before still more water is added.
findings.explanation: The English omits the immediate bursting condition from the comparison.

findings.highlight: I get the bad image of it explo
findings.evidenceJa: 破裂して、その中身を外にぶちまける
findings.governingReading: The premonition includes the balloon bursting and spewing its contents outside.
findings.explanation: The interrupted English stops at “explo—” and loses the expelled contents that define the feared aftermath.

findings.governingReading: Shirou realizes they will be caught up in the coming rupture.
findings.explanation: The English turns involvement in the predicted disaster into literal upward suction by the shadow.
